paragraphs.text: Just open your browser — get all your work done.
A home for your AI coding work.
Conversations, tools, and collaboration in one browser or desktop workspace.
**English** · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · Website · Docs · Downloads
Watch the walkthrough · MP4
## Your project, within reach
| Keep your flow
| Make room for more
| **Conversations that stay organized.** Run parallel conversations, revisit history, and bring file
s and images into the discussion. | **A choice of engines.** Work with pi, DSH, Claude Code, and Cod

ex, with capabilities specific to each engine.  |
| **Tools beside the conversation.** Browse and ed
it files, preview changes, open a terminal, and inspect Git status and diffs.       | **Collaboratio
n you can follow.** Connect work on a canvas, coordinate Bot groups, and reach connected devices. |
| **A workspace that feels like yours.** Choose themes and languages, with layouts for desktop and m
obile.                            | **Room to extend.** Add Skills, MCP servers, plugins, and UI ext
ensions as your workflow grows.                 |
## Start in two commands
Requires **Node.js 22.19.0 or later**. Run these commands from your project directory.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`pwu`, `piwebui`, and `pi-web-ui` are equivalent commands; all subcommands and options work with eac
h. Use `pwu [directory]` to start in a project directory.

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8787` if the browser does not open automatically.
In workspace settings, conf
igure a model provider and its credentials, select a model, and send your first task.
Prefer a packaged app? Choose an Electron desktop build or Windows portable package.
Installation guide · Workspace documentation
## More than one way to work
Use chat for a focused task, parallel conversations for separate threads, and subagents for delegate

d work.
Plan mode, goal mode, and review delegation provide different ways to organize execution.
To
ol approvals let you review tool actions as part of that workflow.

The workspace supports **pi, DSH, Claude Code, and Codex** through their respective integrations.
Se
ssion formats, configuration, tools, and available controls vary by engine.
In a pi-hosted workspace, native CLI conversations can also run local pi, Claude Code, Codex, or a c

onfigured DSH terminal profile.
These are interactive terminal sessions that use each CLI's own inst
allation, login, and permissions; they do not inherit every chat feature.
Execution modes · Native CLI details
## Give the work a canvas

Connect task steps, follow runs, and inspect logs and artifacts in a visual workflow.
Canvas collabo
ration brings handoffs and review into view, so the shape of a larger task stays readable.

Canvas supports execution tracking, approval branches, and reviewable artifacts.
Where Git isolation
is enabled and supported, changes remain available for inspection and explicit adoption.
Canvas architecture and behavior
## Connect people, agents, and machines
Use the device center to work with connected machines and their supported remote desktop and file ca

pabilities.
Bot groups bring device-backed agents into a shared conversation for coordination and ta
Bot groups bring device-backed agents into a shared conversation for coordination and task dispatch.
Extend the workspace with **Skills, MCP, and plugins**: add tools, reusable instructions, or your ow

n interface contributions.
Browse the community plugin directory, or start with the plugin SDK.
Device center · Bot groups and collaboration · MCP and browser tools
## Pick your place to work
| Entry point                     | A good fit for
| A good fit for                                                                   |
| **Web**                         | Opening the workspace in a browser, locally or through a configu

red service.     |
| **Electron desktop**            | A desktop application with a built-in browser

and local workflow integration.    |
| **Windows portable**            | A packaged Windows entry p

oint; check the release notes for included components. |
| **Background service / Docker** | Keeping
the workspace available on your own machine or server.                   |

Model credentials are configured separately from the app installation.
For remote access, use the de
ployment guide to configure authentication and your network entry point.
Background service · Docker installation · Deployment guide · CLI and environment
